title: Morning Wisdom
body: Proverbs 30 is the humble confession of Agur — a man who begins not by boasting of wisdom but by admitting how small he is before the Almighty. That posture is itself the doorway to wisdom: the fear of the Lord that knows its own limits. Agur marvels at the God who holds the wind in His fists and binds the waters in a garment, and he begs for just two things — to be kept from lies, and to be given neither poverty nor riches, lest abundance make him proud or want make him a thief.
